components.name: Primary Link

components.name: Search Trigger

components.css: .ds-search-trigger { min-width: 16rem; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.6rem; padding: 0.48rem 0.55rem 0.48rem 0.72rem; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #bac4d3); border-radius: 0.45rem; background: var(--surface, #fff); color: var(--muted, #5d687d); font: 1rem/1.7 ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; text-align: left; } .ds-search-trigger svg { width: 1rem; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.8; } .ds-search-trigger span { flex: 1; } .ds-search-trigger kbd { padding: 0.08rem 0.35rem; border: 1px solid var(--line, #d9dfE9); border-radius: 0.25rem; background: var(--surface-muted, #f0f3f8); color: var(--faint, #626d81); font-size: 0.69rem; } .ds-search-trigger:hover { border-color: #8fa2c1; color: var(--ink, #172033); } .ds-search-trigger:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #8eabff; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Active Navigation Item

components.css: .ds-nav { width: 15rem; display: grid; gap: 0.12rem; font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-nav a { display: block; padding: 0.38rem 0.7rem; border-radius: 0.35rem; color: var(--muted, #5d687d); font-size: 0.88rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.35; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav a:hover { background: var(--surface-muted, #f0f3f8); color: var(--ink, #172033); } .ds-nav .ds-nav-active { background: var(--blue-wash, #eaf0ff); color: var(--blue-deep, #193b9b); font-weight: 680; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #8eabff; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Code Block
components.description: A dark, scrollable command surface with a reveal-on-hover copy action.
components.css: .ds-code-block { position: relative; margin: 1.6rem 0; } .ds-code-block pre { margin: 0; padding: 1.15rem 1.3rem; overflow: auto; border: 1px solid #263247; border-radius: 0.45rem; background: var(--code, #111827); color: var(--code-ink, #edf2ff); font: 0.82rem/1.65 "Cascadia Code", "SFMono-Regular", Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace; } .ds-code-block button { position: absolute; top: 0.55rem; right: 0.55rem; padding: 0.3rem 0.55rem; border: 1px solid #42516a; border-radius: 0.3rem; background: #1c2739; color: #cbd5e6; font: 0.7rem ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; opacity: 0; transition: opacity 140ms ease-out, background 140ms ease-out; } .ds-code-block:hover button, .ds-code-block button:focus-visible { opacity: 1; } .ds-code-block button:hover { background: #29364b; color: #fff; } .ds-code-block button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #8eabff; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Review Status Strip

components.css: .ds-search-dialog { width: min(42rem, calc(100vw - 2rem)); max-height: min(38rem, calc(100vh - 4rem)); border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #bac4d3); border-radius: 0.65rem; background: var(--surface, #fff); color: var(--ink, #172033); box-shadow: 0 1.25rem 4rem rgba(22, 32, 51, 0.22); font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-search-field { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.7rem; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #d9dfE9); } .ds-search-field svg { width: 1.2rem; fill: none; stroke: var(--muted, #5d687d); stroke-width: 1.8; } .ds-search-field input { min-width: 0; flex: 1; border: 0; outline: 0; color: var(--ink, #172033); font: inherit; } .ds-search-field button { padding: 0.28rem 0.48rem; border: 1px solid var(--line, #d9dfE9); border-radius: 0.3rem; background: var(--surface-muted, #f0f3f8); color: var(--muted, #5d687d); cursor: pointer; } .ds-search-field button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #8eabff; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-search-dialog p { padding: 1.2rem; color: var(--muted, #5d687d); text-align: center; }

narrative.overview:
BOS Core is a restrained technical reading system: a light mineral frame, a white document sheet, cool rules, ink text, one blue action family, and an amber review warning. It favors orientation, legibility, and evidence over marketing gestures or decorative spectacle.

The interface is compact around navigation and generous in the reading column. Its hierarchy comes from weight, measure, rules, and tonal surfaces rather than illustration or heavy elevation. `docs/` remains the canonical content source; `site/build.mjs` owns semantic structure, `site/src/styles.css` owns this visual system, and `site/src/site.js` owns only navigation, search, copy, and table-of-contents behavior.
keyCharacteristics: Flat, cool-toned documentation surfaces with a single blue interaction family.
Dense navigation surrounding a calm, readable central sheet.
Persistent, unmistakable separation between review evidence and release certification.
Small system-sans type and restrained radii rather than expressive display styling.

rules.name: The One Blue Voice Rule
rules.body: Blue communicates action, selection, or linked structure; do not introduce competing accent hues.

rules.name: The Evidence Amber Rule
rules.body: Amber is reserved for review and certification caveats, never routine decoration.

rules.name: The Literal Material Rule
rules.body: Use monospace for commands, code, identifiers, and version literals, not as a decorative brand font.

rules.name: The Reading Measure Rule
rules.body: Do not widen prose beyond 70ch to fill available space; the surrounding rails may grow or disappear instead.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Persistent reading and navigation surfaces use tone and rules; shadows belong only to transient layers.

dos: Do preserve the white reading sheet, mineral frame, cool rules, and single blue interaction family.
Do keep release caveats in the persistent amber review strip and retain their exact meaning.
Do keep long-form prose at 70ch or less and preserve the desktop-to-drawer responsive model.
Do provide visible focus, reduced-motion behavior, keyboard-operable overflow, and semantic interaction states.
donts: Don't add marketing hero treatments, ornamental illustration, gradients, or competing accent colors.
Don't turn the amber review state into a decorative badge or imply production certification.
Don't add shadows to persistent cards, navigation, code, or reading surfaces.
Don't move canonical content or behavior into the stylesheet; content stays in `docs/`, structure in `site/build.mjs`, and interaction in `site/src/site.js`.
